note: Cross-domain capabilities. Implementation lives in features/ or backend/ (kit_paths); domains depend on these ids instead of redefining them. Implementation status is computed by tools/kb.py from whether kit_paths contain files.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Sign-up, sign-in, sessions, password reset, MFA, SSO where needed.

features.name: User management
features.description: User profiles, invitations, activation, deactivation.

features.name: Organizations and multi-tenancy
features.description: Tenants/workspaces, membership, tenant isolation, locations/branches under a tenant.

features.name: Roles and permissions
features.description: RBAC/ABAC checks enforced by the API on every mutation.

features.name: Audit log
features.description: Append-only record of who changed what and when.

features.name: Notifications
features.description: In-app, email, SMS, and push delivery with templates and preferences.

features.name: File upload and storage
features.description: Uploads, object storage, signed URLs, virus scanning where needed.

features.name: Search
features.description: Full-text and faceted search across domain records.

features.name: Filtering and pagination
features.description: Server-side list filtering, sorting, and pagination.

features.name: Settings
features.description: User and tenant preferences and configuration.

features.name: Dashboard shell
features.description: Authenticated app shell and landing workspace; layout varies per product.

features.name: Reporting and analytics
features.description: Aggregated metrics, charts, exports.

features.name: Subscription billing
features.description: Plans, subscriptions, invoices for the SaaS operator charging its tenants.

features.name: Payment processing
features.description: Charging end customers through a payment provider; refunds; webhooks.

features.name: Background jobs
features.description: Queues, scheduled and retried work (BullMQ).

features.name: Logging and observability
features.description: Structured logs, correlation IDs, health checks.

features.name: Real-time updates
features.description: Server push via WebSocket/SSE for live boards, status, chat.

features.name: Internationalization
features.description: Translations, locale formats, RTL layout.

features.name: Calendar and scheduling UI
features.description: Calendar views, time-slot pickers, recurrence.

features.name: In-app messaging
features.description: Threaded conversations between users or with customers.

features.name: AI assistant
features.description: LLM chat/agent over domain data via the ai-service.

features.name: Document e-signature
features.description: Send documents for signature and store signed copies with an audit trail (consents, leases, contracts).

features.name: Identity verification
features.description: Verify a person's identity or run background/KYC checks through a provider.

features.name: Custom fields
features.description: Tenant-defined fields on domain records, with validation, filtering, and display.

features.name: Data import and export
features.description: CSV/XLSX import with validation, bulk export.
